opening: Unlock and walk the shop — check nothing was left powered overnight
Turn on shop air compressor; verify regulator at 120 PSI
Check 3D printer farm for overnight failures; clear plates
Empty any full scrap/waste bins from yesterday
Verify first-aid kit and fire extinguisher are in place
closing: Power down every machine at its switch (not just the controller)
Drain air from pneumatic lines; compressor off
All tools back to their labeled drawers/bins — StackTech drawers closed
Sweep floors; vacuum machine chip trays
Take out trash if > half full; sort scrap metal into the recycle bin
Last mentor out checks the curing oven and heat press are OFF and cool

weekly: WAZER: check tank abrasive level, drain used-abrasive buckets if > half full
Laser optics: inspect (clean only if hazy) on Nova 35 and MetalFab
Blow dust out of powder booth filters; replace box-fan filter if caked
Printer farm: wipe PEI plates with IPA; wash with Dawn and warm water when adhesion drops; check nozzle wear on machines running filled filament
Charge all M12/DeWalt batteries; report any that won't hold charge
Restock small-parts bins from bulk stock; note anything below reorder point
monthly: WAZER: full maintenance per the maintenance manual (nozzle, mixing tube, tank clean-out)
Lathe: oil ways and leadscrew, check belt tension
Bandsaws: check blade tension, tracking, and tire condition
Press brake: grease ram guides; verify backgauge calibration
Curing oven: inspect door seal and thermocouple reading vs. a reference thermometer
Test emergency stops on every CNC machine
Inventory pass on the consumables ledger — reorder anything below minimum

wazer-pro.task: Drain used abrasive from tank buckets
Clean cut bed slats and flip/replace

hp-t630.task: Check ink levels before large prints

light-armor-oven.task: Verify PID temp vs reference thermometer

prusa-farm.task: Wash sheets with dish soap when adhesion drops
